turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hello there! How's your day treating you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I just realized my passport expires in five weeks and my trip to Peru is in three.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay, that's worth acting on today. Many countries want your passport valid for six months after you arrive.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Right, next thing. Summer holiday with three kids under ten, and my husband and I want different things.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Don't weigh in yet, Moshi, there's more than one and I want to cover them all.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: He wants a theme park resort in Florida, which the kids would adore but it's crazy expensive.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'd love a lake cabin up north where they swim, catch frogs and go to bed early.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My mum suggested we stay with her in the city and do day trips to the zoo and the beach.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or a camping style holiday park with pools and kids' clubs, somewhere in between.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's all I've got. Which would you choose?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Florida would be magical for that age but it's a lot of money and queues. The lake cabin and your mum's place are both relaxed and cheaper. If you need a compromise, the holiday park splits the difference.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Possibly for this trip. Check the official entry rules for Peru, and look at your passport office's fast track service.
